prerequisites: Start the application with: npm run check
context.entryPoint: Open the Detailed UAT report link below.

steps.title: Final handoff contains detailed steps and prepared links
steps.expected: The package starts with version, environment, role, prerequisites, safe account reference, entry point, and estimated time; it provides ordered one-action-at-a-time steps with expected results and pass/fail checkboxes, plus descriptive links to applicable environment, build, code, report, issue, documentation, and evidence resources.
steps.judgment: Confirm the prepared evidence matches the expected result.

steps.title: Project UAT environment becomes evidence-backed long-term memory
steps.precondition: A project has reusable local or staging UAT facts, fixtures, and known workarounds.
steps.action: A task starts, preflight succeeds, or UAT discovers a verified change.
steps.expected: OpenATDD retrieves only relevant project memory, records sources and `last_verified_at`, automatically merges newly verified non-secret facts, marks conflicting facts stale instead of silently deleting history, and reuses the refreshed profile on later tasks.
steps.judgment: Confirm the prepared evidence matches the expected result.

steps.title: Local test credentials load from a dedicated ignored env file
steps.precondition: Local UAT requires a username, password, organization, or similar test-only value.
steps.expected: Non-secret environment YAML references variables from `.env.openatdd.local`; an empty `.env.openatdd.example` can be committed; the real local file is Git-ignored; values are used at runtime but never copied to state, memory, reports, evidence, command output, or logs and are always represented as `[REDACTED]` outside the login action.
steps.judgment: Confirm the prepared evidence matches the expected result.

steps.title: Environment preflight prevents avoidable UAT detours
steps.precondition: The approved solution is ready for implementation or pre-UAT.
steps.action: OpenATDD runs automatic preflight without adding a human gate.
steps.expected: It verifies project/worktree identity, service ports, application version, start commands, login capability, role or organization, third-party configuration, entry URL, deterministic fixtures, and relevant known issues; failures produce an actionable list and formal browser UAT does not start until required checks pass.
steps.judgment: Confirm the prepared evidence matches the expected result.

steps.title: Browser UAT runs in cohesive batches
steps.precondition: Preflight has produced an approved-journey execution plan.
steps.expected: It groups setup and login, the primary business journey, and final readback/evidence into a small number of scripts; it reads DOM and captures screenshots at meaningful checkpoints or on failure instead of after every click; any failed batch can be narrowed for diagnosis without rerunning unrelated completed setup.
steps.judgment: Confirm the prepared evidence matches the expected result.

steps.title: Formal evidence is collected only after repairs finish
steps.precondition: An acceptance failure has opened an issue or changed product code.
steps.expected: OpenATDD requires root cause, regression protection, and invariant, closes all issues, advances a verification epoch, invalidates earlier formal results, rejects passed acceptance records while an issue remains open, and captures the complete journey evidence only in the current clean epoch.
steps.judgment: Confirm the prepared evidence matches the expected result.

steps.title: Test and acceptance order minimizes repetition without weakening coverage
steps.precondition: A task has focused affected paths and risk-proportionate checks.
steps.expected: OpenATDD runs focused tests during edits, relevant module checks after repairs, broad tests and builds once after code freeze, and one final complete approved UAT journey; it records phase timing and warns when environment discovery or browser round trips exceed the configured budget without treating elapsed time alone as a quality failure.
steps.judgment: Confirm the prepared evidence matches the expected result.
